chunks: My father, may Allah have mercy on him, said: Muhammad ibn Yahya narrated to me, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from al-Ubaydi, from Muhammad ibn Sulayman al-Basri, from al-Husayn ibn Umar, who said: I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): A man bequeathed to me (to spend) in the Path. He said: So he said to me: Spend it in Hajj. He said: I said: Indeed, he bequeathed to me in the Path. He said: Spend it in Hajj, for I do not know a path from His paths better than Hajj.

key_terms.السَّبِيلِ: The Path (of Allah), a general term for charitable expenditure or jihad

ai.seo_question: What is the best way to spend money bequeathed for the 'Path of Allah' if not specified?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Mani al-Akhbar*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the interpretation of 'Sabil Allah' in the context of bequests, prioritizing Hajj as the supreme manifestation of this concept. This ruling reflects the Shia scholarly view that while 'Path of Allah' can encompass various charitable acts, the Imam's discretion determines the most meritorious application, here elevating the spiritual and communal benefits of Hajj above other general expenditures.
